Garlic Butter Shrimp Pasta 🍤🧄

Ingredients:
- 1 lb large shrimp, peeled
- 12 oz linguine
- 4 tbsp butter
- 6 cloves garlic, minced
- 1/4 cup white wine
- 1 lemon, juiced
- 1/4 cup parsley, chopped
- Red pepper flakes to taste
- Salt and pepper

Steps:
1. Cook pasta according to package directions
2. Melt butter in large skillet over medium heat
3. Add garlic, cook until fragrant (30 seconds)
4. Add shrimp, cook until pink (3-4 mins)
5. Pour in wine and lemon juice, simmer 2 mins
6. Toss in cooked pasta and parsley
7. Season with salt, pepper, red pepper flakes
8. Serve hot with extra lemon!
